added.summary: A document's text input that a pad gives the focus opens an on-screen keyboard docked at the screen's bottom: letters with shift and caps, symbols, a number pad, and with `lang="ja"` the kana table with composition. Its keys edit the bound value; `type` and `inputmode` pick the layout, `enterkeyhint` labels Done, `inputmode="none"` opens none (docs/ui.md §2.3). The document form of the onScreenKeyboard builder.
